F1: Successful cleanup batches log at ERROR level with full ID lists, creating noisy error logs on every configured run.
F2: Repeatedly formatting the growing ID string causes excessive copying for large SQLite batches.
F3: Large batches can exceed non-SQLite bind-parameter limits and make cleanup fail.
F4: The broader cadence change is real, but the finding does not establish that running these jobs more often causes a defect.
